name: internal-consistency
operation: check held items against each other; no new input
valid_on: two or more holdings that make claims about the same referent or share a dimension
the holdings were not all formed the same way — correlated error is invisible to this mode
breaks_when: coherence read as correctness — a consistent wrong set passes
run only on holdings sharing one formation; correlated error is invisible to it
used as a substitute for residual rather than a filter before it

sub_modes.d1_dimensional: units, sign, conservation. decisive when it fires.
sub_modes.d2_semantic: one term carrying two referents. catches category collapse.
sub_modes.d3_lineage: support graph. finds circulation and floating holdings.

uptake_maintained_by: holding enough of the set in view at once for two items to be compared, and keeping the dimensional and semantic passes in practice
uptake_decays_when: the set grows past what can be held together, or one term's two referents become habitual enough to stop reading as two — the contradiction is still there and stops being seen

provenance.note: id, name, channel, operation, cost, lands_on, receipt_recoverable, breaks_when, sub_modes and status are the author's text, quoted verbatim from the tier spec. valid_on, uptake_maintained_by and uptake_decays_when were written during the build — valid_on because the schema requires it and the spec's entry omitted it
